description.value: Caffè Cittadella is an espresso bar and bistro housed in a heritage building dating to 1894, complete with a scenic outdoor patio that makes it a welcoming rest stop. The menu spans specialty coffee, teas, fresh-baked pastries, breakfast and lunch sandwiches, soups, and a full bar including wine, beer, and cocktails. A curated thrift boutique operates on the second floor, giving the stop an unusually eclectic character.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 48m; rack at 88m.
